job.title: Construction Estimator
job.description:
Construction Estimator
Salary:  $120,000 – $140,000 (Depending on experience)
Location: Fawkner
Hours: Mon-Fri, 08:00 – 16:00
 
About the Role
Due to ongoing team growth, we are looking for a skilled and motivated Estimator to join our construction division. Partnering with Directors, Senior Project Managers, and key trade partners, you will drive the preparation of accurate, value-driven estimates and tenders across commercial and industrial builds. This position is ideal for a commercially sharp professional who thrives on detail and succeeds in a dynamic, deadline-driven construction setting.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop precise construction estimates, quantity take-offs, and competitive tender submissions.
  • Analyse architectural, structural, and engineering documentation, plans, and technical specifications.
  • Request, evaluate, and compare subcontractor and supplier quotes to assemble detailed trade packages.
  • Spot cost risks, potential scope gaps, exclusions, and variations during the pre-construction phase.
  • Oversee pricing databases and work alongside project management on procurement strategies and cost planning.
  • Deliver value engineering options and cost-saving measures to optimise overall project budgets.
  • Engage directly with trade contractors, vendors, design consultants, and project stakeholders.
  • Perform on-site inspections and pre-bid site visits as required.
Required Experience & Skills
  • Demonstrated background (ideally 3 years minimum) estimating within the Australian commercial or industrial construction sector.
  • Proficiency in reading technical construction drawings, structural plans, and project specifications.
  • High-level numerical, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities with keen attention to detail.
  • Sound knowledge of local building codes, modern construction methodologies, and current market trade rates.
  • Strong track record of managing multiple tenders simultaneously while strictly meeting bid deadlines.
  • Excellent negotiation and interpersonal capabilities to build solid trade and client relationships.
  • Strong software literacy, particularly with Microsoft Excel and dedicated construction estimating software.
  • Valid Australian driver’s licence and a self-driven, collaborative work approach.
